caption:
Nine documents. One inconsistency. That is all it takes.

Officers are not reading each document in isolation. They are checking whether the set agrees with itself.

Your bank statement should support your itinerary. Your itinerary should match your reservations. Your cover letter should explain both. One date that drifts, and the whole file starts being read differently.

slides.headline: NINE DOCUMENTS. ONE INCONSISTENCY.
slides.note: Officers are not reading documents in isolation. They are checking whether the set agrees with itself.

slides.body: Your statement should support your itinerary. Your itinerary should match your reservations. Your letter should explain both.
slides.note: Consistency is unglamorous, and it decides more outcomes than anything else.

right.title: What breaks it
items: A date that drifts by two days
Funds that do not cover the plan
A purpose that shifts between documents

slides.headline: ONE DRIFTING DATE CHANGES HOW THE WHOLE FILE READS.
WHERE THE INCONSISTENCY COMES FROM
slides.never: Assemble the documents over several weeks, changing the plan as you go, and never re-read the earlier ones. The file ends up describing three slightly different trips.
slides.instead: Fix the itinerary first, then build every document to match it, then read the whole set once more before submission.
